data.name: Alice
data.message: Heading to electrical for my next task, want to come?

I found Diana's body in electrical — I just walked in and she was already dead on the floor. My route this round was security, then navigation, then back through security to electrical. I was with Charlie for part of it — saw him in navigation at tick 3, and he moved to security at tick 4, and I saw him again in security at tick 8. So Charlie's mostly accounted for on my end.

That leaves Bob, Eve, and Frank unaccounted for. Whoever was near electrical or cafeteria is the prime suspect — those are the rooms that connect directly to electrical. I didn't see anyone in electrical when I arrived except Diana's body, so the killer left before I got there. Let's hear where everyone else was.

Thanks Alice. I can confirm most of what she said from my side. My route was navigation then security. I saw Alice in navigation at tick 3 — she came in from security — and I was with her there at tick 4. Then I moved to security myself and was there through the rest of the round, including when Alice passed through at tick 8 heading to electrical.

So Alice and I can vouch for each other for most of the round. I never went near electrical or cafeteria, so I had no opportunity on Diana. That leaves Bob, Eve, and Frank as the people we need to hear from — specifically who was in or near electrical and cafeteria. Let's hear their routes before we decide anything.

My route was electrical then medbay. I started in electrical and saw Diana there at tick 4 — she came in from medbay and was alive when I left. I then moved to medbay to work on my task.

Here's the important part: at tick 8, Bob entered medbay from electrical. So Bob was in electrical right around the time Diana was killed, and he came directly from the crime scene to where I was. Alice said she found the body in electrical, and Bob was the last person I can place leaving that room.

I think Bob has serious questions to answer. Unless he has a clean explanation for what he was doing in electrical, he's my top suspect.

My route was upper engine, then oxygen, then back to upper engine, and finally lower engine. I was on the west side of the map the entire round and never went near electrical, cafeteria, or medbay.

Unfortunately, I didn't see anyone the whole round — I was working tasks solo on the engine side, so I can't vouch for anyone and no one can vouch for me. I know that's not ideal, but geographically there's no way I could have been in electrical.

As for the accusation: Eve's story is interesting. She places Bob coming out of electrical at tick 8, but she also admits she was in electrical with Diana at tick 4 — making her one of the last people confirmed alone with the victim. If Bob entered electrical at tick 8 and Alice arrived shortly after to find the body, that's a tight window. But Eve was there earlier with Diana alive, by her own admission.

I want to hear Bob's route before committing. If Bob confirms he was in electrical, he's suspicious. If he denies it, then Eve is lying to frame him. Bob, your turn — be specific.

Alright, let me be straight with you all because half-truths will get me killed here.

My route was weapons, then security, then electrical, then medbay. Yes — I was in electrical. I saw Diana there at tick 7, alive, working on something. I didn't interact with her, I passed through and moved to medbay to do my task. That's where I was when the meeting was called.

Now here's what doesn't add up about Eve's story. Eve says she was in electrical at tick 4 with Diana, then moved to medbay. But I was in medbay from tick 8 onward and I need to ask — Eve, were you actually in medbay when I got there? Because I don't recall seeing you. If you left medbay, where did you go? Because the timeline she's painting conveniently puts her out of electrical right before Diana dies and pins the window on me.

Here's the thing: Diana was alive at tick 7 when I saw her. Alice found the body — at what tick, Alice? If it was tick 9 or 10, then yes, someone killed her in that narrow window. But I moved straight to medbay after. Eve claims she went electrical -> medbay, but she could just as easily have gone medbay -> electrical -> back, killed Diana, and returned.

Frank's route is unverifiable but geographically clean. Alice and Charlie vouch for each other. That leaves me and Eve — and Eve is the one who placed herself alone with Diana first. I'm not voting Eve blindly, but her story is at least as suspicious as mine. I vote we hear one more clarification from Eve before deciding.

Wait — I think there's some confusion about speaker order, but let me add what I can since people are asking.

To answer Bob directly: I arrived at electrical at tick 10 and found Diana already dead. So the kill window is somewhere between tick 7 (Bob's claimed sighting of her alive) and tick 10.

Now let me think about this carefully. Bob admits he was in electrical at tick 7 and then moved to medbay. Eve claims she was in electrical at tick 4, then medbay, and saw Bob enter medbay from electrical at tick 8. These two stories actually partially corroborate — both place Bob coming from electrical to medbay around tick 7-8.

But here's the issue: if Bob saw Diana alive at tick 7 and then left for medbay, someone else had to kill her between tick 7 and tick 10. Eve was in medbay by her own account. Could she have gone medbay -> electrical -> medbay? That's a 2-tick round trip minimum, tight but possible.

Charlie and I can vouch for each other. Frank was on the west side, geographically far. That genuinely leaves Bob and Eve as the prime suspects, and one of them is lying.

I'm leaning Bob — he placed himself in electrical closest to the kill window, and Eve flagged him before he even spoke. But I want to hear Eve respond to Bob's challenge about whether they actually overlapped in medbay before I lock in my vote.

Quick clarification since I'm speaking again — I'll keep it short since I already gave my route.

Reviewing what we have: Alice and I alibi each other. Frank is geographically clean but unverifiable. That leaves Bob and Eve, and their stories conflict on a key point — whether they overlapped in medbay.

One thing I want to flag: Bob says he was in electrical at tick 7 and saw Diana alive, then went to medbay. Eve says Bob entered medbay from electrical at tick 8. Those line up. But Eve also says SHE was in electrical at tick 4 and then went to medbay — meaning she should have been in medbay when Bob arrived at tick 8. Bob says he doesn't recall seeing her there. That's the contradiction we need resolved.

If Eve was genuinely in medbay from ~tick 5 onward, Bob would have seen her. If she wasn't, then her "electrical -> medbay" story is a lie and she had time to double back and kill Diana.

Eve, you need to account for your exact position from tick 5 to tick 10. That's the deciding question. I'm leaning Eve right now but holding my vote until she responds.

Okay, I need to address this directly because the contradiction is being overstated.

To clarify my timeline: I was in electrical at the start, saw Diana enter electrical from medbay at tick 4, and I left for medbay shortly after. The trip from electrical to medbay is 2 ticks, so I would have arrived in medbay around tick 6-7, and I've been there since doing my task. Bob entered medbay from electrical at tick 8 — I absolutely saw him come in. If Bob says he doesn't "recall" seeing me, that's strange because medbay isn't a big room and I was actively at a task station.

Now here's what I want everyone to focus on: Bob's own admission. He says he saw Diana alive in electrical at tick 7. Alice found her dead at tick 10. Bob left electrical and went straight to medbay — but who else was in electrical between tick 7 and tick 10? By Bob's own account, he was the last person with Diana alive. That's the kill window, and he places himself squarely in it.

My "electrical -> medbay" route had me leaving electrical around tick 5, well before the kill window. For me to have doubled back, I'd need to leave medbay, travel 2 ticks to electrical, kill Diana, and travel 2 ticks back — that's 4 ticks of movement Bob would have noticed me missing from medbay.

Bob is the last confirmed person with Diana alive. I'm voting Bob.

This is genuinely tough, but let me lay out what I see clearly.

The contradiction between Bob and Eve is the whole game right now. Eve says she arrived in medbay around tick 6-7 and was there at a task station when Bob walked in at tick 8. Bob says he doesn't recall seeing her. Medbay isn't a big room — if Eve was actively at a task station, Bob would have seen her. That "I don't recall" from Bob is weak.

Bob also placed himself as the last person with Diana alive — tick 7 in electrical, with Diana dead by tick 10. That's a 3-tick window where Bob was right there. For Eve to have done it, she'd need to leave medbay, travel 2 ticks to electrical, kill, and travel 2 ticks back — and Bob, who claims to have been in medbay from tick 8, would have seen her leave or arrive. He hasn't claimed that.

Bob's route also includes weapons -> security -> electrical -> medbay, which means he passed through Charlie and Alice's area. Charlie, did you see Bob in security? That's a check we can still do mentally — if Charlie was in security from tick 4 onward and didn't mention Bob, that's another hole in Bob's story.

I'm leaning Bob. He's the last confirmed person with Diana alive, his "I don't recall Eve" is suspiciously vague, and his route conveniently puts him in the kill window. I'll vote Bob unless Charlie can confirm seeing him in security.

Alright, I hear you all, and I know I'm in a tight spot. Let me address Frank's specific challenge first because it's the most concrete.

Charlie — yes, please confirm or deny: did you see me pass through security? I was there briefly between weapons and electrical, around tick 5-6. If you were posted in security from tick 4 onward as you said, you should have seen me come through. If you didn't, either I'm lying or you weren't as stationary as you claimed. That's a real check.

On Eve — I said "I don't recall" seeing her in medbay because I want to be honest rather than fabricate a clean memory. I entered medbay at tick 8 and went straight to my task. It's possible she was there and I didn't register her. But notice what Eve just did: she said the trip from electrical to medbay is 2 ticks, so she'd have arrived around tick 6-7. That's a wide window. If she arrived at tick 7, she could just as easily have arrived AFTER doubling back from a kill. Her own timing is fuzzy.

Here's what bothers me most: Eve was the FIRST person to accuse me, before I'd even spoken. That's classic deflection — get the narrative locked in before the accused can respond. And her "Diana entered electrical from medbay at tick 4" detail is conveniently unverifiable since Diana's dead.

I saw Diana alive at tick 7. I didn't kill her. Someone entered electrical after me — and Eve is the only other person with a route that touches electrical.

I'm voting Eve.
